GENERAL M922/M922A EQUALIZER MODULES The M922/M922A Stereo and Mono Equalizers operate in conjunction with the M901 series of input modules. A High-Pass filter with a 75 Hz corner frequency maybe inserted separately, pre-equalizer, or not at all. Insertion is tallied by the LED located in the insertion switch. The equalizer separates the audio into three separate bands. Low frequencies from 20 Hz to 500 Hz are adjustable over ±15 dB of range. The low frequency section imparts a shelving response to the audio spectrum. High frequencies are also equalized with a shelving characteristic. Continuously adjustable boost or cut (+15 dB) is provided. The high frequency section can tailor the signal response from 1.8 kHz to 15 kHz. The mid frequency section controls equalization of signal from 400 Hz to 6.4 kHz, and has a bell-shaped characteristic curve. This section has a ±15 dB adjustment range. The quality factor ("Q") is 2. The equalizer insertion switch is provided with an integral LED totally it's operation. All insertion switching in the M922/M922A is performed using solid-state analog switches. No audio is switched directly from the front panel. The equalizer is packaged ina single module size of 1.5" wide x 8.0" high x 6.6" deep. The M922/M922A is powered by ±23 volts DC.
